content.subject: Re: Sounds from C3
content.body:
Delgado,

You asked me to write it down so here it is.

It's not the vents. I know what the vents sound like. This is something else — rhythmic, wet almost. Comes from behind the north wall panel around 0300. I went down there last night with a torch. The panel was warm. Not equipment-warm. Different.

I told Verlaine. She logged it as acoustical artefact and closed it. I'm not writing this up officially because I don't want to be the crazy one. But I wanted someone else to know.

Don't tell anyone I sent this.

— Chen

P.S. Kowalski replaced the vent again. He looked scared when I asked him what he found in the duct.
